name: ioStart

notifications.label: Kitchen timers
notifications.hint: When a timer you started from the start page's search box ends

notifications.label: TRMNL screens
notifications.hint: When one of your TRMNL screens runs low on battery, or sends you what it shows

settings.name: HA_FEED
settings.label: Follow Home Assistant live
settings.hint: Off: no standing connection to Home Assistant; the page asks every few seconds instead.

settings.name: NEWS_LOOP
settings.label: Fetch followed feeds in the background

settings.name: PHOTO_STRIP
settings.label: Photos under the tiles
choices: A row of photos at random
settings.hint: What everyone sees under the tiles; each person may pick another in Customize.

settings.name: WEATHER_UNITS
settings.label: Weather in
settings.hint: Each person may pick their own in Customize.

settings.name: WEATHER_LOCATION
settings.label: Weather location
settings.hint: The place Settings › Weather picked, as AccuWeather's own key for it.

settings.name: WEATHER_LOCATION_NAME
settings.label: Weather location name
settings.hint: What that place is called, as AccuWeather gave it.

settings.name: HA_URL
settings.label: Home Assistant address
settings.hint: http://homeassistant.local:8123, or wherever it answers. Its token is under Keys and tokens.

settings.name: HA_NAME
settings.label: What Home Assistant calls the house
settings.hint: Learned when Settings › Home Assistant tests the connection.

settings.name: HA_ENTITIES
settings.label: Home Assistant things shown
settings.hint: The lights, switches and sensors picked in Settings › Home Assistant.

settings.name: HA_BUILTIN_ALERTS
settings.label: Home Assistant's own warnings
settings.hint: Show the warnings Home Assistant itself raises on the start page. Off: only the things picked above.

mcp: The suite's one MCP server: an AI assistant connected here with an ioStart app password uses every app's tools as you (each app's own MCP server has to be on), and suite admins can update every app at once.
